Name: Serpent Smiter (Nerf Serpents)
Author: FallenFeces
Description:
Hi. My name is Feces. I hate serpents. I [i]really[/i] hate serpents. There's just something about them. I hate their damage, their health, their... speed. I hate being taken by surprise. I hate when they waste my time as they swarm on me, feeling the tickle of their whiskers on the trail down my spine. I hate... Oh, I'm sorry. I got myself all worked up... Would you like me to nerf serpents for you?

Installation: Unzip the "[CP] SerpentSmiter" folder into your mods folder.

This is my first mod btw.

Downloads.Description: Nerfs Serpents to have half their base health and almost half their base damage. I halved the speed but I didn't really see a difference.

Manifest.Name: SerpentSmiter
Manifest.Description: This mod pumps molten lead into the urethra of every serpent in the game, causing them to be massively nerfed!
Manifest.Author: Fallen Feces
